tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhiṃ/ 'dir srid pa gsum gyi bla ma dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yab/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog /sa skya'i bla chen rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan/ /sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen par gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod grangs med bskal pa'i sngon rol nas/ /yan lag bdun ldan go 'phang mchog brnyes kyang / /gzhan ngor sprul sku du ma'i zlos gar mkhan/ /sngags 'chang༞ thub dbang pad 'byung srong btsan sgam po'i dus/ /mau 'gal bu dang shrī singha'i mtshan/ /blon po rig pa can sogs skur sprul pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ gzhan yang gangs can 'gro ba'i mun sel mchog /skad gnyis smra ba'i sgra bsgyur lo tsā ba/ /du ma'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ dus 'dir 'gran zla bral ba'i gdung rigs kyi/ /rigs gsum rnam sprul rgyun chad med pa'i rgyud/ /lha babs 'khon rigs sa skya par 'khrungs pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ 'khrungs ma thag nas sngon gyi bag chags kyis/ /ngo mtshar chos dang mthun pa'i rtsed 'jo las/ /tha mal byis pa'i spyod pa kun spangs pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ na tshod gzhon yang blo gros kun rdzogs pas/ /'di ni 'jig rten kun gyi mes po zhes/ /dpyod ldan rnams kyis mgrin gcig rab bsngags pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ de tshe chos kyi rtsa ba yi ge dang / /klog dang kha don gzhung lugs chen po 'ga'/

/lan re zung re tsam gyis khong chud pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ dus der 'jam dbyangs ngur smrig na bza' dang / /gos dkar lcang los mdzes pa mched kyi drung / /sa skya'i yab chos mtha' dag legs nos pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ gzhan yang rdo rje 'chang chen mi yi zol/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i mus pa rje/ /gang gi thugs rje'i lcags kyus myur drangs pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ de tshe rje btsun 'khor lo sdom pa dang / /mjal ma thag nas thugs yid gcig 'dres shing / /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mchog tu dbang bskur ba'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ dus der sa skya'i rje btsun las 'ongs pa'i/ /zab rgyas chos tshul sgo brgya'i gnyer gtad nas/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ khyab bdag mus pa chen po'i zhal snga nas/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob par/ /nam yang 'bral ba med pa'i zhal lung brnyes/ /sngags 'chang༞ gzhan yang skyes chen mkhas dang grub pa'i mchog /bgrang yas bsten nas gsan pa rgya mtsho yi/ /pha mthar son kyang ngoms med blo gros can/ /sngags 'chang༞ bzo gso sgra dang tshad ma nang don rig /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi yi don/ /gzigs pa tsam gyis don rnams khong nas grol/ /sngags 'chang༞ gzhan yang snyan ngag mngon brjod zlos gar sogs/ /mkhas pa rnams la grags pa'i shes bya'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji bzhin gzigs pa'i spyan yangs pa/ /sngags 'chang༞ kun gyis rtogs par dka' ba'i gnas 'ga' zhig /'di don ci zhes bsam pas de ma thag /rgyu mtshan dang bcas rang shar tshul gyis rtogs/ /sngags 'chang༞ 'chad na mkhas pa kun gyi yid 'phrog cing / /rtsod na log lta'i dregs pa rtsad nas 'joms/ /rtsom na shes bya'i gnas kun rab gsal ba'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ zab rgyas chos tshul mi 'dra brgya 'gyed cing / /kun kyang de nyid kho na sbyangs pa ltar/ /smra ba'i dbang po kun gyis 'gran bral ba'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan ngag dbang chos grags kyis/

/mgon khyod thams cad mkhyen par mtshan gsol te/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyis mdzad pa'i kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum gyi don 'grel khog phub gnad kyi lde mig ces bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi bskul ba po'i skabs su/ mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug bdag chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag gi dbang po kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos nor 'dzin ma'i zla ba'i skyes gnang dang bcas bka' mchid bdud rtsi'i dog pas bskul ba las zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /rtag tu gus dang sri zhu cher mdzad pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ lha mchog yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dang / /rdo rje'i chos skyong mthu rtsal can rnams kyi/ /grangs dang mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ dpal ldan stobs kyi mgon po la sogs pa/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma du mas byin brlabs shing / /bstan srung rnam 'phrul mtha' dag nyer gzigs pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ gzhon nu'i dus nas mngon par shes pa dang / /chos kun gnas lugs gzhi med rtsa bral gyi/ /ye 'jam chen po'i rang zhal rjen par gzigs/ /sngags 'chang༞ sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan dang mus chen rjes/ /mgon khyod ma 'ongs dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /chos srid kun gyi bdag por lung bstan pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ bstan srung gtso bos bstan pa'i gnyer gtad cing / /zhing skyong dbang pos 'bral med skyong pa dang / /'phrin las mgon pos bka' bab mtshan ma brnyes/ /sngags 'chang༞ skal ldan rnams la chos 'khor skor ba'i tshe/ /lha yis me tog sil mas rtag mchod cing / /srung mas gdug can dngos su cham la 'bebs/ /sngags 'chang༞ 'gro rnams rims nad drag pos gzir ba na/ /khyod kyi nus pas nad rnams kun zhi nas/ /grangs med 'gro la srog gi sbyin pa mdzad/ /sngags 'chang༞ gzhan yang 'jig rten lo dgras nyen pa'i tshe/ /sa phyogs de nyid zhabs kyis bcag tsam gyis/ /lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa'i dpal ster ba'i/

/sngags 'chang༞ gnas chen rnams su ngo mtshar ltas mang dang / /ri gzar rbab kyi gnod pas mi brdzi sogs/ /rmad byung grub pa'i mtshan ma mtha' yas pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ mtshan ldan bla ma rnams kyis lung bstan bzhin/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan pa'i khur chen po/ /rgyal sras khyod kyis ngal ba lhur mdzad pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ rje btsun gong ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i thabs/ /rten gsum bzhengs dang dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sogs/ /kun kyang dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ khyod kyi dpal 'byor longs spyod ji snyed pa/ /kun kyang 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i snyen bkur gyi/ /rgyun bzang gong nas gong du 'phel mdzad pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ dam rdzas 'chi med ril bu sgrub pa'i tshe/ /rtag par mkha' la 'ja' 'od gur khang dang / /dri bzang dang bcas ril bu rab 'phel ba'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ phyi ltar 'phrin las rnam bzhis bstan pa spel/ /nang du zab mo'i lam la gcig tu dril/ /rtag tu chos mthun bya bas dus 'da' ba'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ khyod kyis che phra'i bya ba 'ga' zhig la/ /gsol ba btab na rtsa rgyud bla ma dang / /srung mas 'od gsal ngang du lung ston pas/ /sngags 'chang༞ dkon mchog mchod sogs byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i khyad par bgrang yas sogs/ /ci mdzad bstan dang 'gro ba'i don gyur pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ de phyir dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid kyi/ /dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar rab rgyas te/ /ljongs 'dir bstan 'dzin yongs kyi rgyan gyur pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ e ma sngon gyi skyes chen sngags 'chang rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen nyid/ /slar yang byon pa lta bu'i mdzad 'phrin can/ /sngags 'chang༞ dpal ldan 'phags pa mya ngan 'das rjes su/ /sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor phun tshogs rnams/ /khyod dang mtshungs pa gzhan med nus pa'i gter/ /sngags 'chang༞ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs dang /

/mkhas shing grub pa'i blo gros kun ldan pas/ /deng sang thub dbang bstan pa'i srog shing mchog /sngags 'chang༞ mgon po khyod kyi dri med rigs kyi sras/ /brgyud par bcas sogs dngos brgyud slob tshogs kyis/ /srid mtha'i bar du bstan pa 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /sngags 'chang༞ de ltar mkhyen brtse nus pa kun gyi gter/ /skyabs gnas bslu med thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos/ /'brel tshad don ldan khyod la gsol btab pas/ /bsam don 'di dag myur du 'grub gyur cig /bstan dang 'gro la phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /sngags 'chang bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan cing / /bstan 'dzin bu slob bstan skyong sbyin bdag sogs/ /kun gyi thugs bzhed ma lus 'grub gyur cig /de la brten nas spyi dang bye brag gi /bstan pa rin chen mchog tu rab 'phel nas/ /'jig rten khams kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /bde skyid ldan zhing chos mthun spyod gyur cig /'khor 'das byed po gzhan med rang gi sems/ /snang ba ma 'gags rkyen gyis sna tshogs 'char/ /shar tsam nyid nas rang gi ngo bos stong / /myong stong brjod bral gnas lugs rtogs gyur cig /de lta'i zung 'jug lta ba'i rtsis zin pa'i/ /mnyam gzhag rjes thob spyod lam phra mo tshun/ /sna tshogs thabs la mkhas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa byang gyur cig /mdor na rdo rje 'chang dngos sngags 'chang rje/ /khyod kyi rnam thar brjod cing gsol btab pas/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar/ /'dren mchog khyed kyis rjes su 'dzin gyur cig/ //ces dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gsol ba 'debs pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba 'di yang / mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa rim par byon pa rnams/

gdul bya gzhan gyi snang ngor grub pa'i mtshan ma brnyes pa'i tshul 'dzin pa'i gang zag khyad par can mang du byon yang / 'dir ni grub pa nyid du ma zad par/ mkhas pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par nyid gzhan las ngo mtshar ches mchog tu che bar mthong nas de nyid rgyan gyi dam par byas te/ gsol 'debs shlau ka kun gyi mjug tu yang / sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa zhes pa'i tshig sbyor gyis brgyan pa 'di ni/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa chen po rab 'byams smra ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa zung gis yang yang du bskul ba dang / rang nyid kyang bdud las kyi mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ shākya'i dge slong byams pa kun dga' don grub kyis rje nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar gyi cha cung zad 'di rnams/ zhabs drung du yun ring gnas pa dag gi ngag 'gros dang mthun par bkod de/ sa pho 'brug gi lo dbo'i zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes lnga gza' skar 'dzoms pa'i nyin/ lo dgon pa'i gzims chung lcang lo can du sbyar ba 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig /'dis bdag dang bskul ba po rnams kyi 'di phyi'i bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //ka lya na wardhandu// //shu bhaṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 a myes zhabs/ 'jam mgon a myes zhabs la gsol ba 'debs pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i gter/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
